What layout components do they use (PageHero, Section, SectionTitle, CtaBand, tables, FaqJsonLd)? Show the exact structure/skeleton I'd copy for a new comparison page, including how metadata is exported and how FaqJsonLd is used.

2. MARKETING LAYOUT PRIMITIVES: List every exported component in components/marketing/primitives.tsx and components/marketing/sections.tsx with its props (PageHero, Section, SectionTitle, CtaBand, PricingGrid, Reveal, etc.). I need to know exactly what's available to compose pages.

3. PRODUCT OFFERING (for accurate copy): What does Nxeon actually offer? Find: the VPS plans (specs/prices — from db.plan or a seed/config), the one-click apps / OS images / templates available (for "host X" use-case pages — grep for app catalog, cloud-init templates, one-click, marketplace), the game-server types supported (for game hosting pages), the datacenter/region locations, and the headline features (NVMe, dedicated IP, DDoS, backups, root, etc.). 3b. STRUCTURED DATA: components/marketing/StructuredData.tsx — the exact signatures of FaqJsonLd, ProductJsonLd, and any Breadcrumb/Article helpers, so I can add rich results to each new page.

4. NAV + FOOTER (internal linking): Where is the marketing header nav defined (components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx) and the footer? I need to know how to add links to new landing pages (mega-menu / footer columns) for internal linking. Show the structure.

5. SITEMAP: app/sitemap.ts — how static routes are listed (I'll add the new pages there). Show the exact array shape.

6. Any existing "use-case" or "solutions" landing pages already present (grep app/(marketing) for game-servers, wordpress, minecraft, docker, vpn, etc.) so I don't duplicate.

Return a build-ready reference.
